title: Hmm-Humming Cuttlefish
statement: A small, lantern-glow cuttlefish drifts above a bed of sea glass, arranging pebbles into spirals and question marks while ripples of pattern pass across its skin as it ponders. When a visitor leans close, it pauses, tilts its head, shimmers a gentle hello, and nudges one pebble toward the glass as if to ask what you think.
